mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that reduce recession risk and boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals a tightening labor market that accelerates hiring and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 9.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer and business confidence that accelerates economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift to combat inflation reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC is positive over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95, it indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth that precedes higher corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 375,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer spending momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 375000, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
